cautions: Supplied technical research, pending independent archived-source verification. PDF titles and verification labels do not constitute an independent database audit. No Shockbase used.
Exact regional watch identifiers remain separate; partial family codes and unresolved LIW references do not count as individual watch variants. No invented color suffixes or merged LCW/LIW prefixes.
Module 4319 receives Japan JJY 40/60 kHz and US WWVB 60 kHz, not Multi Band 6. World-time city coverage does not establish radio-transmitter compatibility.
Oceanus T1010 module 5141 is family-assigned in the supplied PDF. Nominal dimensions and approximate mass do not establish individually verified dimensions or weights.
Module 5141 has conflicting 18- versus 23-month power-saving runtime reports. CTL920F describes a cell, not a confirmed tab/terminal-equipped Casio service assembly.

Existing scalar facts are preserved; approximate family measurements, archival dates/prices and reported battery data retain their qualifications. Original PDFs, scans and full conversations are excluded from publication.
